# xp

> CLI tool for posting to X (Twitter) from your terminal. Single binary, zero dependencies.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/tawachan/xp#readme): Full documentation, installation, and usage guide
- [Getting Started](https://github.com/tawachan/xp#getting-started): Setup guide with X Developer Portal
- [Usage](https://github.com/tawachan/xp#usage): All available commands
- [Output Format](https://github.com/tawachan/xp#output-format): Machine-readable output specification
- [How It Works](https://github.com/tawachan/xp#how-it-works): Architecture and flow diagrams
- [Releases](https://github.com/tawachan/xp/releases): Download binaries

## Quick Reference

Post a tweet: `xp "Hello, world!"`
Post a thread: `xp thread "First" "Second" "Third"`
Reply to a tweet: `xp reply <tweet_id> "text"`
Fetch a tweet: `xp get <tweet_id>`
List your tweets: `xp me [limit]`
Delete a tweet: `xp delete <tweet_id>`
Authenticate: `xp auth login`
Log out: `xp auth logout`
Upgrade: `xp upgrade`
Show config: `xp config show`
Set config (non-interactive): `xp config set --api-key=KEY --api-secret=SECRET --access-token=TOKEN --access-token-secret=TOKEN_SECRET`

Add `--json` to any command for JSON output: `xp me --json | jq '.[0].text'`

Note: `get` and `me` require a paid API plan (Pay-Per-Use or Basic).

## Output Format

Success (exit code 0):
```
tweet_id: 1234567890123456789
url: https://x.com/i/status/1234567890123456789
```

JSON (with --json flag):
```
{"tweet_id":"1234567890123456789","url":"https://x.com/i/status/1234567890123456789"}
```

Error (exit code 1, stderr):
```
error: <message>
```

## Install

```
curl -fsSL -L https://github.com/tawachan/xp/releases/latest/download/xp-darwin-arm64 -o /usr/local/bin/xp && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/xp
```
